text:
Team, the nightly job failed because the server's disk hit 98% full, leaving no room to write its output. Log rotation was disabled back in January, so logs piled up until the disk ran out of space. It slipped through the cracks.

We freed up 40 GB by clearing out the old logs, then reran the job. It finished successfully at 02:40.

Log rotation is back on, so this shouldn't happen again. We're also looking at adding a disk usage alert so we catch it earlier next time.

I can share details on the cleanup or the alert setup if you want them.
